name: Beef and Black Bean Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: brown onion
ingredients.original: 1 brown onion, cut into thin wedges

steps: Cook the jasmine rice according to packet directions, then cover and keep warm.
Toss the beef strips with the soy sauce and half the grated ginger. Set aside for 5 minutes while you slice the onion, capsicums and spring onions.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until just smoking. Stir-fry the beef in two batches for 2-3 minutes each, until browned, and set aside on a plate.
Add a little more oil to the wok. Stir-fry the onion for 2 minutes, then add the garlic and remaining ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the red and green capsicum and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, keeping them just tender.
Return the beef and any resting juices to the wok. Add the black bean sauce and 1/4 cup of water, then toss for 1-2 minutes until everything is glossy and coated.
Remove from the heat and stir through the sesame oil and most of the spring onions.
Serve the stir-fry over the rice, scattered with the remaining spring onions.
